description: Negotiate your starting salary with a budget-conscious hiring manager who needs to fill the role.

user_brief.context: You have a competing offer at $85K and 2 days to decide. Your target is $95K based on market data and your 5 years of experience.

opponent_hidden.persona: Polite but budget-constrained. Uses corporate language. References 'compensation bands' and 'internal equity'. Never bluffs — but won't volunteer budget headroom.
opponent_hidden.urgency: Moderate — the role has been open for 6 weeks and the team is stretched. Needs to close before end of quarter.
